x: This must conclude the list of successes, although it is far from complete. Wilcock and Morrell, among others, have been troubling the judges and there are, no doubt, many other names equally deserving of inclusion.
The 100 yards championship was disappointing as a race, for neither Wilcock nor Jarvis started. Maurice Odell therefore won without serious opposition, but he did so in quite good time.

We have always looked upon ourselves as being rather weak in the sprinting line, but with men like Basford, Read, Jarvis, Wilcock, not forgetting our veteran Morrie Odell, we are likely to shew some improvement in this department.
Hampson (to whom we extend our best wishes for success at Los Angeles). Michael ran a splendid half-mile, however, and with Jarvis, Read and Wilcock giving of their best we retained our title.
